# Site build rules

<!-- Generated by `node scripts/build-rules/gen.mjs` from `build-rules.mjs`. Edit the registry, not this file. -->

A brief build turns a template into the business's own site. These rules hold for every site it builds, whatever the
trade, the template or the CMS. Each rule lives once, in the registry
(`packages/wo/website-opportunities/domain/build-rules.mjs`): its final checks run at the end of every build on the
served pages, and their findings go on the build's receipt. A finding of a **blocker** rule makes the build end in
Needs fixes; a **note** is reported only. A template gets the declarations below or the packing check
(`scripts/slot-roles/check.mjs`) refuses it.

## The six site build rules

1. Copy keeps the template layout: the demo length and line count, one shape for siblings. Carried by `sibling-copy-shape`, `sibling-record-pages`, `offering-rows`.
2. Copy first, then pictures: each frame shows its own record, a drawing is never reused on another record. Carried by `sibling-record-pages`, `pictures-fit-record`.
3. The template structure is kept: a missing part is written in the shape of its siblings, hidden only when the grid survives. Carried by `demo-content`, `sibling-record-pages`, `structure-kept`, `layout-bands`.
4. Icons are chosen by item meaning, one neutral icon for a whole row when nothing matches. Carried by `icons-per-meaning`.
5. The footer keeps the template footer shape, the Contact page carries every channel. Carried by `footer-shape`, `contact-page`.
6. Demo and showcase pages and menus are removed, menu titles take only page or record names. Carried by `showcase-removed`, `menu-label-is-page-name`.

## Every rule

### `demo-content` (blocker)

No word, picture, person or fact of the template demo is left on a slot the build did not fill.

- Checked by: `demo-leftovers`, `people-cards`, `statistics`, `offering-summaries` (`build-rule-checks.js`).
- Writers that take its words: page-copy, offering, sibling, record-page, cta-band, repair.
- A template declares: the slot roles: a known role on every text and picture slot.
- Writer and check per CMS: Joomla writer yes, check yes; WordPress writer yes, check yes; EmDash writer yes, check yes.

### `form-without-recipient` (blocker)

A form a visitor can fill in always sends to the owner's own email.

- Checked by: `contact-forms` (`build-rule-checks.js`).
- A template declares: nothing.
- Writer and check per CMS: Joomla writer yes, check yes; WordPress writer yes, check yes; EmDash writer no, check yes.

### `record-not-from-brief` (blocker)

A review, its author, a person's name and a figure are shown exactly as the brief gives them, never invented.

- Checked by: `record-slots`, `review-quotes` (`build-rule-checks.js`).
- Writers that take its words: page-copy, record-page, repair.
- A template declares: packing rule `social-in-person-card`.
- Writer and check per CMS: Joomla writer yes, check yes; WordPress writer no, check yes; EmDash writer no, check yes.

### `missing-head-block` (blocker)

Every page carries the brand colours and the layout fixes the build owes it.

- Checked by: `head-blocks` (`build-rule-checks.js`).
- A template declares: nothing.
- Writer and check per CMS: Joomla writer yes, check yes; WordPress writer no, check yes; EmDash writer no, check yes.

### `link-without-job` (blocker)

Every button and link leads somewhere real, never to its own page or to an empty frame.

- Checked by: `demo-leftovers`, `self-links`, `buttons-videos` (`build-rule-checks.js`).
- A template declares: `slots[].action` in the content map: an action on every button slot (`buttonActionProblems`); packing rule `hero-button-no-link`; packing rule `link-target-wrong-role`; packing rule `video-slot-names-no-video`.
- Writer and check per CMS: Joomla writer yes, check yes; WordPress writer yes, check yes; EmDash writer yes, check yes.

### `sibling-copy-shape` (blocker)

The cards of one list share one text shape: the demo length and line count, no sparse card beside a full one.

- Checked by: `sibling-copy` (`build-rule-checks.js`).
- Writers that take its words: page-copy, offering, sibling, record-page, repair.
- A template declares: packing rule `repeated-item-ungrouped`; packing rule `outline-item-unroled`; packing rule `card-title-link-undeclared`.
- Writer and check per CMS: Joomla writer yes, check yes; WordPress writer no, check yes; EmDash writer no, check yes.

### `sibling-record-pages` (blocker)

Sibling record pages each show their own pictures and words, no empty card and no blog pager.

- Checked by: `record-pages` (`build-rule-checks.js`).
- Writers that take its words: record-page.
- A template declares: `recordPages` in the content map: the layout of every family of record pages (`recordPageProblems`).
- Writer and check per CMS: Joomla writer yes, check yes; WordPress writer no, check yes; EmDash writer no, check yes.

### `footer-shape` (blocker)

The footer keeps the template footer shape: one line of each channel kind its demo shows.

- Checked by: `demo-leftovers`, `footer-navigation` (`build-rule-checks.js`).
- Writers that take its words: footer, repair.
- A template declares: `contactBlocks` in the content map: every footer contact block and its demo entries (`contactBlockProblems`); `navigationGroups` in the content map: every footer link column (`navigationGroupProblems`).
- Writer and check per CMS: Joomla writer yes, check yes; WordPress writer no, check yes; EmDash writer no, check yes.

### `contact-page` (blocker)

The Contact page lists every channel the brief holds, each one a link, and never invites a walk-in to a business by appointment.

- Checked by: `contact-page` (`build-rule-checks.js`).
- Writers that take its words: page-copy, repair.
- A template declares: nothing.
- Writer and check per CMS: Joomla writer yes, check yes; WordPress writer no, check yes; EmDash writer no, check yes.

### `pictures-fit-record` (blocker)

Each picture shows its own record and page: a photo or a drawing never stands on another record's page.

- Checked by: `record-pictures` (`build-rule-checks.js`).
- Writers that take its words: picture, drawing.
- A template declares: packing rule `gallery-group-is-a-card`.
- Writer and check per CMS: Joomla writer yes, check yes; WordPress writer yes, check yes; EmDash writer yes, check yes.

### `kept-page-missing` (blocker)

Every page the site keeps opens.

- Checked by: `pages-served` (`build-rule-checks.js`).
- A template declares: nothing.
- Writer and check per CMS: Joomla writer yes, check yes; WordPress writer yes, check yes; EmDash writer yes, check yes.

### `structure-kept` (note)

The template structure is kept: no empty frame, every kept band with its message, each page intro in its place.

- Checked by: `empty-frames`, `page-intros`, `cta-bands` (`build-rule-checks.js`).
- Writers that take its words: page-copy, cta-band, repair.
- A template declares: `ctaBands` in the content map: every call-to-action band and its message slots (`ctaBandProblems`); packing rule `section-body-undeclared`.
- Writer and check per CMS: Joomla writer yes, check yes; WordPress writer no, check yes; EmDash writer no, check yes.

### `layout-bands` (note)

A decoration never stays alone once the working parts beside it come off.

- Checked by: `empty-frames` (`build-rule-checks.js`).
- A template declares: `layoutBands` in the content map: every band of working and decoration parts (`layoutBandProblems`).
- Writer and check per CMS: Joomla writer yes, check yes; WordPress writer no, check yes; EmDash writer no, check yes.

### `icons-per-meaning` (note)

Each item's icon says what the item is; a row with no fitting icons shows one neutral icon on every item.

- Checked by: `icon-rows` (`build-rule-checks.js`).
- Writers that take its words: page-copy, repair.
- A template declares: packing rule `item-icon-ground-undeclared`.
- Writer and check per CMS: Joomla writer yes, check yes; WordPress writer no, check yes; EmDash writer no, check yes.

### `showcase-removed` (note)

Demo and showcase pages of the template, and their menu entries, are gone.

- Checked by: `demo-leftovers` (`build-rule-checks.js`).
- A template declares: `showcase-nav-map.json` beside the content map: the template's showcase menus (checked with the contract pins).
- Writer and check per CMS: Joomla writer yes, check yes; WordPress writer yes, check yes; EmDash writer no, check yes.

### `menu-label-is-page-name` (note)

A menu or footer link is named by the page or record it opens, one name per page across the site.

- Checked by: `main-menu`, `buttons-videos` (`build-rule-checks.js`).
- Writers that take its words: menu, footer, repair.
- A template declares: nothing.
- Writer and check per CMS: Joomla writer yes, check yes; WordPress writer yes, check yes; EmDash writer yes, check yes.

### `offering-rows` (note)

No line under an offering's name only repeats it, and one list's cards share one set of row labels.

- Checked by: `offering-rows` (`build-rule-checks.js`).
- Writers that take its words: offering.
- A template declares: packing rule `offering-rows-short`.
- Writer and check per CMS: Joomla writer yes, check yes; WordPress writer no, check yes; EmDash writer no, check yes.

### `seo` (note)

Every kept page says its planned title and description, and the not-found page speaks for the business.

- Checked by: `page-seo` (`build-rule-checks.js`).
- A template declares: nothing.
- Writer and check per CMS: Joomla writer yes, check yes; WordPress writer no, check yes; EmDash writer no, check yes.

### `copy-voice` (note)

The site speaks in one formal voice: no slang, no advertising tone, one spelling of each word.

- Checked by: `sibling-copy` (`build-rule-checks.js`).
- Writers that take its words: page-copy, offering, sibling, record-page, cta-band, repair.
- A template declares: nothing.
- Writer and check per CMS: Joomla writer yes, check yes; WordPress writer no, check yes; EmDash writer no, check yes.

### `repeated-copy` (note)

No sentence is said twice, on one page or on two.

- Checked by: `repeated-copy` (`build-rule-checks.js`).
- Writers that take its words: page-copy, sibling, record-page, repair.
- A template declares: nothing.
- Writer and check per CMS: Joomla writer yes, check yes; WordPress writer no, check yes; EmDash writer no, check yes.

### `repeated-blocks` (note)

A showcase block the site keeps on one page is on one page only.

- Checked by: `repeated-blocks` (`build-rule-checks.js`).
- A template declares: nothing.
- Writer and check per CMS: Joomla writer yes, check yes; WordPress writer no, check yes; EmDash writer no, check yes.

### `booking-buttons` (note)

A button whose words name booking or contact leads to the Contact page or to a channel of the business.

- Checked by: `booking-buttons` (`build-rule-checks.js`).
- A template declares: nothing.
- Writer and check per CMS: Joomla writer yes, check yes; WordPress writer no, check yes; EmDash writer no, check yes.

### `demo-name-addresses` (note)

No page address still carries the name of a demo person the page no longer shows.

- Checked by: `demo-name-addresses` (`build-rule-checks.js`).
- A template declares: the slot roles: person.name and quote.author_name roles on the demo names.
- Writer and check per CMS: Joomla writer yes, check yes; WordPress writer no, check yes; EmDash writer no, check yes.

### `first-screen-and-facts` (note)

The home page's first screen says what, where and how to contact, and every contact fact of the brief is on the site.

- Checked by: `contact-facts`, `hero-first-screen` (`build-rule-checks.js`).
- A template declares: nothing.
- Writer and check per CMS: Joomla writer yes, check yes; WordPress writer yes, check yes; EmDash writer yes, check yes.
